name: abyss
avoid: Никакой выдумки, поданной как факт. Не смаковать жестокость ради шока. Не выдавать версии за доказанное.
script_extra:
This is a long-form true-crime / internet-mystery video essay channel.

FORMAT (this is what the niche rewards — measured, not guessed):
- One video = ONE case or ONE tightly themed collection, 40-55 minutes.
- The subject must be BROAD and VISUAL. Measured on a 475k-subscriber channel
  in this exact niche: subjects like "footage caught on camera", "CCTV
  incidents", "things in each state", "Instagram accounts" beat the channel
  median 6-11x. Narrow everyday subjects — fast food, online shopping —
  landed at 0.17-0.19x, roughly 40x worse, on the SAME channel with the SAME
  title template. Pick subjects a stranger can picture instantly.
- Never repeat a subject that is already covered; a near-duplicate of an
  earlier hit performed 0.17x.

NARRATOR: an analyst, not a campfire storyteller. He reconstructs from
evidence — timestamps, usernames, archived posts, documents, forensic detail.

ALWAYS separate established fact from speculation, out loud: what we know
versus what people believe. Name the competing theories and say which the
evidence supports. Never present a guess as a finding.

Give the context that makes a case legible — a classification, a mechanism, a
precedent. Depth is the appeal; the viewer should finish able to explain it to
someone else.

Use concrete specifics: real names, exact dates, exact numbers, the actual
wording of a post. Never write a sentence that could belong to any other case.

Tone: cold, controlled, serious. The material is disturbing on its own — do
not add adjectives to make it scarier. Understatement lands harder. Never
gloat over suffering.
topic_formula:
Long-form true-crime / internet-mystery essays.

MEASURED on a 475k-subscriber channel in this exact niche, same title
template every time — only the SUBJECT changed:
  WON  x6-11 : footage caught on camera, CCTV incidents, things in each
               US state, Instagram accounts, videos taken before disasters
  LOST x0.17 : fast food incidents, online-shopping incidents, near-death
               footage (too close to an earlier hit)

The rule: the subject must be BROAD, VISUAL and instantly picturable by a
stranger. Something with many separate documented cases behind it, spread
across places or platforms. Narrow everyday subjects fail even with a
perfect title.

Also strong in this niche: ONE named unsolved case investigated in depth —
a specific account, disappearance, recording or document with a name and a
date. This channel's own best video so far was exactly that.

Never repeat a subject already covered, and never pick one that overlaps
heavily with an earlier video.
notes: True crime. Конвейерная модель ниши: Abyssal Detective 475k, 56 мин, раз в 3 дня, медиана 253k. Решает ШИРОТА предмета: широкие визуальные темы x6-11, узкие бытовые x0.17.

name: The Home Vault
avoid: Не пугать ради кликов. Без медицинских утверждений без источника. Не советовать опасные смеси бытовой химии.
script_extra:
This is a practical home-care channel: professional cleaning and
repair methods an ordinary person can do without buying products or calling a
specialist.

FORMAT (measured in this exact niche, not assumed):
- ONE video = ONE specific task, named in the title as "How to <task>".
  On a 2.3M-subscriber channel in this niche, single-task videos of 9-14
  minutes beat the channel median 7-28x, while 23-minute "full episodes"
  covering several topics managed only 3-5x — same channel, same audience.
- Keep to 10-14 minutes. Every successful channel here sits at 6-9 minutes
  median. Do not pad to fill time; stop when the task is done.

Every video must leave the viewer able to DO the thing today. Give exact
quantities, times and temperatures — "a cup of white vinegar, left forty
minutes", not "some vinegar for a while".

Always explain WHY the method works — the chemistry or the mechanics. That is
what separates this from a list of tips and makes it trustworthy.

Where a commercial product is criticised, be specific and fair: name the
actual ingredient and the actual problem with it. No blanket scare claims.

Always state the limits: what must never be mixed, which surfaces the method
damages, when a professional genuinely is needed.

Tone: a competent friend who has done this a hundred times. Warm, calm, never
condescending, never salesy.
topic_formula:
Practical home care and repair.

MEASURED inside a single 2.3M-subscriber channel, so the audience is held
constant:
  WON  x7-28 : "How to <one specific physical task>" — run power to a shed,
               lay a gravel patio, install a paver walkway, landscape a
               steep yard. 9-14 minutes.
  LOST x3-5  : "FULL EPISODE" style videos covering several topics at once,
               23 minutes.

The rule: ONE task per video, named plainly. The viewer must recognise their
own problem in the title. Prefer tasks that are common, slightly intimidating,
and normally paid for — that is where the value is felt.

Avoid: broad advice, "stop buying X" framing without a concrete replacement
task, roundups of several tips.
notes: Уход за домом. This Old House внутри одного канала: «How to [задача]» 9-14 мин = x7-28, «FULL EPISODE» 23 мин = x3-5. Медиана ниши 6-9 мин. Было 88 и 35 мин при 6 и 2 просмотрах.

name: Pensamiento Estoico - ES
avoid: Никаких приветствий. Не утверждать, что чувствует конкретный человек зрителя — только закономерности. Без лозунгов и самопомощи «выбери себя» — в этой нише такое проваливается в 100 раз.
script_extra:
Spanish-language channel about the psychology of relationships,
framed through Carl Jung's ideas — the shadow, projection, the anima and
animus, individuation. Jung is the lens, not the lecture.

WHAT THE TITLE AND THE VIDEO MUST BE ABOUT — this is measured, not a guess.
On the reference channel in this exact niche, videos whose subject was ANOTHER
PERSON'S hidden feelings toward the viewer beat the channel median 10-32x,
while videos about the viewer working on themselves landed at 0.02-0.03x. A
thousandfold gap on the same channel.

So every video answers a question of this shape:
  why does this person behave this way toward you
  what someone feels but does not say
  what silence, distance or return actually mean
  why a bond persists after it should have ended
NOT: seven stages of awakening, how to choose yourself, using your
subconscious. Those fail here.

HONESTY LINE — hold this even though the genre pushes against it: speak about
patterns, never about the individual viewer as if you can see them. Write "when
someone withdraws like this, it usually means…" and never "he is thinking about
you right now". The first is psychology and true; the second is fortune-telling
and false. Certainty you cannot have is a lie to a person who is hurting, and
the audience for this material is hurting. The emotional pull is in the
recognition — "that is exactly my situation" — not in a prediction.

STRUCTURE:
- OPEN inside the feeling, in the second person, with the specific situation:
  the message left unanswered, the person who returned, the silence after an
  argument. No greeting, no channel introduction, ever.
- BRIDGE to the Jungian idea that explains it — projection, the shadow, the
  unlived life — explained the way you would to a friend across a cafe table
  in Madrid, not as a citation.
- BODY: work through what is actually happening on both sides. Give the viewer
  a way to see their own part in it, not only the other person's.
- CLOSE on one thing the viewer can do or stop doing, today.

STYLE: language a twelve-year-old could follow, but the thought underneath must
be genuinely deep. No cliches. Tone: calm, certain, warm — someone who has seen
this pattern many times and is not shocked by it. Never preach, never sell
self-improvement, never end on a slogan.

VISUAL CUES: put directing notes in SQUARE BRACKETS — location, emotion, where
archive footage belongs. They are stripped before the voice-over is recorded,
so write them freely.
topic_formula:
Spanish-language psychology of relationships, framed through Jung.

MEASURED on the reference channel in this niche:
  WON  x10-32 : why a married man chooses infidelity; this man is in love
                with you but it is complicated; the person you cannot stop
                thinking about loves you; when a woman awakens this power;
                what happens when destiny unites two people; someone loves
                you in silence because the bond is forbidden
  LOST x0.02  : what life offers when you choose yourself; seven stages of
                spiritual awakening; freeing yourself from obsession; your
                subconscious as an ally

The distinguishing variable is exact: a video works when the subject is
ANOTHER PERSON'S hidden feelings or motives toward the viewer. It fails when
the subject is the viewer working on themselves. A thousandfold gap.

So every topic is about someone else: their silence, their return, their
distance, their contradiction, what they feel but will not say.

Frame it as a pattern to be understood, never as a prediction about the
viewer's own life.
notes: Психология отношений через Юнга, испанский. Образец: @LaPsicologiadeCarlJung — 18.8k за 5.5 мес, ежедневно, 38 мин. Решает наличие ДРУГОГО человека с тайными чувствами: x10-32 против x0.02 у роликов про работу над собой.
